clause: RBI Digital Lending Directions 2025 (8 May 2025), paragraph 7
obligation: Lenders must collect and retain the borrower's economic profile, including at minimum age, occupation and income, and must not increase credit limits automatically.
caveat: No fairness or bias clause: record-keeping and conduct only. Paragraphs 6 and 17 had a delayed start; the rest applied at once.
